sources.excerpt: Dirt Preacher by Stomp Under Foot | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Stomp Under Foot Dirt Preacher LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ OVERDRIVE Description The Dirt Preacher is a hybrid between silicon and germanium transistors that gives you a full range of fuzz tones that sounds like a mix between a Big Muff™ and a Tone Bender™ through your favorite, vintage amp. With the gain control around 9-10 o'clock you can get an overdriven tone. When turning the gain between 11-1 o'clock you get a smooth, muff-like fuzz and with the gain all the way up you get a gnarly, gritty, wooly, fuzz that sounds like you are pushing a maxed out Tweed amp. The specifically matched, germanium transistor gives you a vintage grittiness and a little, tube-like sag. Stomp Under Foot browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Stomp Under Foot Dirt Preacher Published on November 18, 2023 Stomp Under Foot fuzz pedal Vintage Mini Vintage Mini Information Stomp Under Foot Stomp Under Foot Dirt Preacher The Dirt Preacher is a hybrid between silicon and germanium transistors that gives you a full range of fuzz tones that sounds like a mix between a Big Muff and a Tonebender through your favorite, vintage amp. With the gain control around 9-10 o'clock, you can get an overdriven tone. When turning the gain between 11-1 o'clock you get more of a muff-like fuzz and with the gain all the way up you get a gnarly mix of muff and Tonbender that starts to get into a gnarly, gritty, wooly, sound. I used four different and specific transistors to get the sound I wanted including a germanium transistor for vintage grittiness in the fuzz and give lead notes a little tube-like sag. As with all Stomp Under Foot pedals, the Dirt Preacher is made by hand, using only quality, through-hole components. Features: NOS Germanium Transistor True-Bypass 9V Battery or 2.1 9V Adapter Only 8mA NOS Parts Handmade in the U.S.A.
